mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lms.tb_subject_daily_log (sub_seq, log_date, content, status, reg_id, period, main_file_path) VALUES (#{subSeq}, #{logDate}, #{content}, #{status}, #{regId}, #{period}, #{mainFilePath}) ON CONFLICT (sub_seq, log_date, period) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, status = EXCLUDED.status, main_file_path = EXCLUDED.main_file_path, update_id = #{regId}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
